dataset_name: Delhi NCR Metro Fare Reference Dataset
scope: Officially published single-journey fare rules/tables for DMRC, Airport Express, and Noida Metro, plus a Rapid Metro source note.
important_limitations: Manually structured from official operator webpages; this is not an operator-provided downloadable dataset.
DMRC standard fares depend on actual network travel distance and day type.
Airport Express fares are an origin-destination matrix.
Noida Metro fares depend on number of stations and day type.
Rapid Metro fare note should be verified before production use.
Smart-card discounts, passes, penalties, and special concessions are not modeled.
